neet_phy_u07_t03_1.working: An orbiting spacecraft is in free fall, so the effective g is zero. With no hydrostatic pressure gradient, there is no buoyant force.

neet_phy_u07_t03_2.working: g_eff = g + a = 12 m/s^2. P = rho*g_eff*h = 1000 x 12 x 0.5 = 6000 Pa.

neet_phy_u07_t03_4.working: At rest: rho*g*h. Upward acceleration: rho(g+a)h. Downward acceleration: rho(g-a)h. Free fall: zero. This gives A-III, B-IV, C-II, D-I.

neet_phy_u07_t03_5.working: A is true (dP/dh = rho*g). B is false: air is compressible and pressure falls roughly exponentially. C is false: the submerged fraction is independent of g_eff. D is true (buoyancy arises from the gravity-induced pressure difference). E is true (no depth-dependent pressure in free fall).
